about: A recipe page read on the iPhone (design note 30 §3; tests/data/gen_recipe_page_vectors.py). Made from app/recipe_import/parse.py, fetch.py and app/egress.py; replayed by tests/js/run_vectors.mjs and the Swift package.

messages.bad_link: That link cannot be read. Use a web address that starts with http:// or https://.
messages.blocked: This server does not open that address. It may be a private or local address.
messages.http_error: The site did not give the page. Check the link, or paste the ingredients instead.
messages.not_html: That link is not a web page. Paste the ingredients instead.
messages.timeout: The page took too long to answer. Try again, or paste the ingredients instead.
messages.too_large: That page is too large to read. Paste the ingredients instead.
messages.too_many_redirects: That link sends the app on to too many other addresses. Use the recipe page's own link.
messages.unreachable: The page did not answer. Check the link, or paste the ingredients instead.

constants.no_lines: No ingredient lines were found. Paste one ingredient on each line.
constants.no_recipe: This page has no recipe data the app can read. Paste the ingredients instead.
